title: What's New: Prepare Your Copilot Extension - Practical Considerations (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Validation in Marketing Text and Documentation
Optimal Tool Quantity and Best Practices

features.name: Copilot Extension Cloud Deployment
features.description: Partners can now upload their Copilot extension to a Business Central sandbox environment and run it in Microsoft cloud using Microsoft AI resources without managing LLM models, deployment, or availability.
caveats: Requires AL sandbox environment
No special programs needed anymore

features.name: Shared Infrastructure for Copilot
features.description: Partners now use the same framework and infrastructure as Microsoft to build Copilot experiences, with extensions going through the IIA toolkit consuming cloud compiled services and accessing large language models.
caveats: Same infrastructure applies to platform fork and agentic frameworks

features.name: GPT-4o and GPT-4o Mini Model Access
features.description: Partners have access to GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini models as flagship models with different capabilities for deep reasoning and fast processing.
caveats: Other models like Deep Seek R1 and reasoning models available elsewhere but not yet in Business Central
Capacity constraints in all Azure regions must be met before rolling out new models

features.name: Azure OpenAI Abstraction Layer
features.description: Partners can request latest GPT-4o or GPT-4o mini models through the abstraction layer without managing different model versions.
caveats: Abstracts complexity of different model versions

features.name: Additional Models Coming When Capacity Available
features.description: Business Central is evaluating Deep Seek R1 and other reasoning models released recently by Microsoft and OpenAI, but will only make them available once sufficient capacity exists across all Azure regions.
caveats: Deep Seek R1 and other reasoning models not yet available
Capacity must exist in all regions where Business Central has customers
Timeline not specified

features.name: Prompt Engineering Guidelines
features.description: Good prompts should be clear, specific, provide enough instructions, and include additional details for creative tasks.
caveats: Testing is more important than prompt styling
Model versions behave differently so test coverage is critical

features.name: Model Version Variations
features.description: Model versions change behaviors overnight and are not necessarily backward compatible. New versions can be faster or cheaper but may regress performance on existing prompts.
caveats: Version updates can cause unexpected prompt behavior changes
Not backward compatible
Email quality regression example shown

features.name: Test Automation for Prompt Validation
features.description: Partners should write test automation from day zero to verify expected outcomes and ensure prompts continue working as models and versions change.
caveats: More important than prompt styling precision
Protects against prompt regression
Multiple BC sessions cover test toolkit and responsible AI principles

features.name: Hallucinations and Fabrications Management
features.description: Large language models fabricate answers by predicting statistically likely text rather than admitting lack of knowledge, especially problematic in Business Central where users need to take trusted actions.
caveats: Models copy response patterns from training data
Can give deceiving answers that sound correct
Critical for business Central domain
Priority number one to tackle

features.name: LLM Response Validation
features.description: A technique to validate that LLM responses are grounded in actual data before surfacing them to users. The approach involves checking if responses are legitimate and not hallucinating before proceeding.
caveats: Requires extra verification time, may add latency
Not yet detailed in initial segment

features.name: Marketing Text Generation with Validation
features.description: A feature that generates marketing text for products while validating that dimensions, numbers, and other details come from the database rather than LLM fabrication. Accuracy improved from 6% to very high numbers through validation.
caveats: Complex validation required for dimensions and properties

features.name: Copilot Documentation Chat with Grounding
features.description: A feature that answers user questions about Business Central documentation by retrieving trusted articles from Microsoft Learn and verifying responses are grounded before showing them to users.
caveats: Requires verification time that may add 200+ milliseconds latency

features.name: Tools for Copilot Extensions
features.description: A concept that allows copilot extensions to define functions or tools that can query Business Central data and inject real-time information into LLM responses. Tools are defined in AL code and enable grounded, verified responses.
caveats: Too many tools reduce reliability; limit to around 5 tools
Requires careful design to avoid overwhelming the LLM

features.name: Function Calling for Copilot
features.description: Support for multiple function calling within AI toolkit to enable copilots to call defined functions in extensions to retrieve and update business data reliably.
caveats: Should use around 5 tools maximum for good accuracy
Technology may improve allowing more tools over time
